title: Toward the Centre
description: The shore runs inward to a place the stone will not
describe, and the descent has walked every stratum
except the one at the very centre of this one.
The dream of return is the fifteenth stratum and it
is not a place. It is what the walk home looks like
from inside, when the surface is close enough to
impossible and the body is doing the walking and the
mind is already at the map room table.
Six stations, the same six, lit in colours the
The archive's record still has its blank line. Home
is the direction that fills it in.
